versions.name: Mabee Scout Reservation
versions.address: 5 miles south of Locust Grove along Spring Creek

features.note: The dining hall is air conditioned.
Modern bathroom facilities with private showers.
All meals are served in the dining hall.
The property hosts high-adventure activity alongside district events and training.
Shooting sports are among the activities the property hosts.

versions.summary: A 600-acre Indian Nations Council reservation near Locust Grove, Oklahoma, hosting Cub Scout resident camp, Webelos Woods, high adventure, and shooting sports.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
